releaseNotes: Adds a one-shot, SMC-only presentation replay when V720's offline artwork gate blocks the initial REST/catalog presentation before the port becomes connected.
Warms the IODD presentation catalog off the WPF Dispatcher, then refreshes only manufacturer/logo and product-image bindings; PDO identity/capability is not changed by the replay.
No V721 Signal Light classification, ICA writer, output-border, or generic connected-edge presentation changes are reintroduced.

en: Fixed the first-start SMC vendor logo and IODD product-image presentation without requiring Disconnect/Connect.
The V720/V722 communication, polling, reconnect, IODD mapping, ISDU, PDO, ICA Tier, and other runtime behavior remain unchanged.
ko: 프로그램 최초 시작 시 SMC 벤더 로고와 IODD 제품 PNG가 표시되지 않고 재연결 후에만 나타나던 현상을 수정했습니다.
V720/V722의 통신, 폴링, 재연결, IODD 매핑, ISDU, PDO, ICA Tier 및 기타 런타임 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.
